## Activity

During July 2021, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 40 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and indicates the volume of work completed at the site during the month. The activity figure is presented as captures rather than as a count of individual people.

## Image quality

Of the 40 captures, 4 were ungradable. The ungradable_rate was 10.0. These figures should be considered together when reviewing the quality of images submitted from Hill Counties Health Centre during July 2021. The image quality results identify the captures that could not proceed to grading.

## Grading

The grading results included 2 referable findings. The median lag was 1. This is the median interval recorded for grading during the reporting period. Together, the activity, image quality and grading figures provide the operational summary for Hill Counties Health Centre for July 2021.
